Great question! Here’s the easiest way to get started on Nelly.com:

Browse by category or search, then choose your size and color.
Use filters for color, size, brand, style, material, and price. Sort by best match, latest arrival, price, or brand.
Click Add, then keep shopping or check out.
Review your items and change the size, remove items, or adjust the amount.
Shop as a member or guest, select delivery and payment methods, review the total, and click Confirm and Complete Purchase.

You’ll see a receipt and receive an order confirmation by email. Hope this makes things feel much simpler! 😊
